title: Technical Recruiter Intern
description:
BlockTXM Inc. (TalentXM) is an AI-powered talent intelligence platform and staffing agency within the XM Ecosystem—encompassing TalentXM, TravelXM, and WellnessXM under the philosophy “Work. Travel. Thrive.” We specialize in healthcare automation, AI agent development, Workato integrations, and fractional talent services. Our operations run on the Zoho ecosystem, leveraging Zoho Recruit, Zoho CRM, Zoho People, Zoho Projects, Zoho Cliq, and Zoho WorkDrive to power seamless, end-to-end talent operations. We also heavily integrate AI and LLM technologies into our daily workflows, utilizing paid platforms such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity Pro to enhance productivity, research, content creation, and candidate engagement.

Role Summary

As a Technical Recruiter Intern, you will support the full-cycle recruitment process for technical roles across the XM Ecosystem. You will gain hands-on experience sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates using the Zoho suite of tools while learning the fundamentals of AI/tech-focused talent acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and identify qualified candidates for technical roles (AI/ML, automation, Workato, healthcare IT) using Zoho Recruit, job boards, and LinkedIn.
  • Screen resumes, conduct initial phone/video screenings, and evaluate technical fit against role requirements.
  • Manage candidate pipelines, update records, and track progress in Zoho Recruit and Zoho CRM.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and communicate with hiring managers and candidates via Zoho Cliq and email.
  • Assist in drafting job descriptions, Boolean search strings, and outreach messages for niche technical positions.
  • Maintain organized documentation and recruitment files in Zoho WorkDrive.
  • Support employer branding efforts by contributing to social media posts and talent community engagement.
  • Participate in team standups and project tracking through Zoho Projects.
  • Leverage AI/LLM tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro) for candidate research, job description drafting, outreach optimization, and recruitment workflow automation.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business, IT, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in technical recruiting, staffing, and the AI/automation industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.
  • Familiarity with Zoho applications or willingness to learn is a plus.
  • Interest in or experience using AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) is an advantage.
  • Prior internship or exposure to recruiting, HR, or tech is a bonus but not required.

What You’ll Gain

  • Certificate of Completion upon successful completion of the internship.
  • Professional Reference Letter from leadership for future career opportunities.
  • Hands-on training on the Zoho ecosystem (Recruit, CRM, People, Projects, Cliq, WorkDrive).
  • Exposure to AI-powered recruitment tools and healthcare staffing operations.
  • Practical experience using leading AI/LLM platforms (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro) in a professional setting.
  • Real-world experience in technical recruiting within a growing startup ecosystem.
  • Mentorship and career guidance from experienced talent acquisition professionals.

Important Note

This is an unpaid internship designed as a professional development opportunity. While there is no monetary compensation, interns will receive valuable industry training, certifications, and reference letters to support their career growth.

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI
description:
Lead Software Engineer - AI



Job-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop production-ready software solutions that solve real business problems, considering business needs and technology/operations landscape; lead interaction with internal stakeholders and technology on specific projects and initiatives
  • Apply software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to derive business value from the full range of internal and external data, leveraging Cloud-based technology

  • Translate complex data and methodology into strategic, operationally feasible insights and recommendations; automate implementation
  • Communicate clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, verbally and visually, to create understanding, engagement, and buy-in
  • Identify trends and opportunities to drive innovation, both in what we do and how we do it; evaluate new software engineering, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies and tools that can boost team performance, innovation, and business value
  • Manage, coach, and mentor a team of software engineers and data scientists, serving as a predominant technical expert

  • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

Additional Qualifications and Skills:

Required skills

  • Bachelor’s/Advanced Degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or 7+ years equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in developing a variety of software products in a commercial environment
  • 2+ years of experience in building generative AI-based products.
  • Strong Python and Typescript/JavaScript skills required;
  • Expertise in multivariate statistical modelling (e.g., clustering, regression, principal components and factor analysis, time-series forecasting, Bayesian methods) and modern machine learning (ensemble methods, regularization, gradient boosting, representation learning, deep neural networks, transformers architectures, self-supervised learning, and MLOps fundamentals) required
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or other), or equivalent on-premise platform
  • Experience working in agile methodology is required
  • Prior experience in leading data science and machine learning based software development projects focused on solving business problems and seizing business opportunities

Desired skills

  • Proficiency in SQL desirable
  • Ability to mentor and lead others; provide hands-on technical guidance; conduct code reviews
  • Ability to simultaneously coordinate and track multiple deliverables, tasks, and dependencies across multiple stakeholders / business areas
  • Experience with deep learning and neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, RNNs, transformers), including generative and self-supervised models, and with frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is desirable.

Proficiency with data visualization tools is desirable

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
About Warmy :)

Warmy.io enhances email deliverability by optimizing domain and IP reputation, ensuring emails land in inboxes instead of spam folders. Our advanced platform simplifies email warming using a unique email seed list.


With integrations like Google Postmaster Tools, Warmy provides actionable insights for superior email performance. Catering to a global audience, Warmy supports email warming in over 30 languages and offers free tools for marketers, such as the Email Deliverability Test and SPF/DMARC Record Generators. Warmy is designed to streamline email deliverability, allowing users to focus on meaningful audience engagement.


Role Description

We are looking for a Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence to own and manage all company analytics. This role is responsible for building a clear view of the business through data, monitoring key metrics on a daily basis, and translating numbers into actionable insights for leadership.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .


Responsabilites:

  • Own the company’s analytics strategy and data visibility across all departments.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.


KPI Monitoring

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:
This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.


FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.


We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions
  • Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the team


You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)
  • Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar)
  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems
  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Position Overview

  • We are seeking a Senior AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer to join Upstart AEC. This role sits at the intersection of large language model (LLM) systems, agentic workflows, and scalable backend architecture.
  • You will design and build production-grade AI applications from the ground up, translating complex business requirements into intelligent, automated systems. The role is backend-first, with a strong focus on AI architecture, integration, and implementation. Frontend exposure is helpful but not the primary focus.
  • You should be comfortable working in cloud environments (on-premise and cloud-based platforms), with strong cloud-agnostic competency. Deep expertise in a specific cloud provider is not required, but a solid understanding of cloud architecture principles is essential.

Key Responsibilities


AI Systems & Architecture

  • Design and build AI-native applications leveraging LLMs and agentic frameworks
  • Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector store integrations
  • Implement autonomous, goal-driven AI workflows using LangChain and related frameworks
  • Ensure performance, observability, and reliability of AI-powered systems
  • Build core AI architecture, integrations, and implementations from scratch or using AI automation platforms for smaller engagements


Application & Backend Development

  • Develop and scale RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
  • Build modern AI applications using Python (primary) and TypeScript
  • Integrate backend systems using Python or Go
  • Design and manage data systems using Postgres and Redis
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and maintain strong development best practices
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate logistics, monetization, and operational requirements into scalable technical systems

Required Skills


Programming & Backend Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend development and AI model integration
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Extensive experience designing, scaling, and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Deep understanding of Postgres and Redis
  • Experience building production-grade systems


AI-Native & Agentic Development

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI principles and autonomous system design
  • Experience working with LLMs and generative AI tooling
  • Practical experience with:
  • RAG architectures
  • Vector databases and embeddings
  • Semantic search
  • Dynamic reasoning and task planning workflows


Cloud & Systems

  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles
  • Comfortable working across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Cloud-agnostic competency (AWS experience is beneficial but not mandatory)


Observability & Tooling (Preferred)

  • Experience with AI observability platforms such as LangSmith or similar tools
  • Familiarity with monitoring, debugging, and optimizing LLM application performance


General & Soft Skills

  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability
  • High ownership mindset — able to independently drive initiatives from concept to deployment
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong product intuition and ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes

What Success Looks Like

  • You independently design and ship scalable, production-ready AI systems
  • You proactively identify architectural improvements and performance optimizations
  • You translate business challenges into intelligent, automated workflows
  • You contribute to building a strong AI-native engineering culture

title: Analista de Relações Governamentais Pleno (BILINGUE - INGLES)
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital.


Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala; 1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente; 23.000 pontos de distribuição; mais de 400.000 colaboradores. Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo.


Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Estamos à procura de pessoas dedicadas e entusiasmadas para se juntarem à nossa equipe como professores de inglês remoto. Esta posição oferece a conveniência de trabalhar de qualquer lugar com horários flexíveis.


Sobre nós:  Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.


Visão geral da posição

  • Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos.
  • Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula.
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos.
  • Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.
  • Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas.
  • Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.


Formato

  • Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI)
  • Local : Remoto
  • Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda


Requisitos

  • Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1)
  • Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula.
  • Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo).
  • Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online.
  • CNPJ / MEI ativo.


Por que se juntar à nós?

  • Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida.
  • Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem.
  • Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino.
  • Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

description:

About the role

Oversee the company’s financial operations ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting across all entities. This role manages monthly financial closes, reconciliations, AP/AR processes, bookkeeping oversight, and financial reporting. The Controller will coordinate with CPAs for tax filings, maintain KPI dashboards, implement financial controls, and provide actionable financial insights to executives and investors.


Responsibilities
  • Oversee and ensure timely and accurate monthly financial closes across all entities
  • Review financial packages, reconciliations, and reports for accuracy and compliance
  • Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bookkeeping processes
  • Supervise Finance Associates and bookkeepers (U.S. and international) ensuring quality and accountability
  • Coordinate with U.S.-based CPAs on tax planning, tax filings, and compliance matters
  • Support owners with legal documentation, compliance filings, and investor documentation
  • Maintain and verify KPI dashboards and financial reporting accuracy
  • Deliver consolidated financial reports within defined timelines after month-end close
  • Implement financial controls, policies, and system improvements to increase operational efficiency
  • Provide executives and investors with financial insights and reporting
  • Collaborate with the CFO on KPI modeling, financial analysis, and strategic financial planning
  • Review financial work completed by Finance Associates and ensure accuracy and deadlines
  • Maintain organized financial documentation and compliance records
  • Ensure investor communications and legal financial documentation are completed on schedule


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting or finance
  • Experience in real estate, construction, or investment management preferred
  • CPA certification preferred
  • Experience managing bookkeepers or finance teams
  • Strong experience with monthly close processes and financial reporting
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with accounting software and financial management systems
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high accuracy in financial reporting
  • Ability to manage multiple financial priorities and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with leadership

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast-paced, growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must .
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Tech Recruiter Júnior
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Recruiter com perfil dinâmico e \"mão na massa\" para liderar nossos processos seletivos de ponta a ponta. Você será a ponte entre o talento e o sucesso dos nossos clientes, atuando em uma consultoria de tecnologia onde a agilidade e a qualidade técnica caminham juntas.


Se você tem olhar crítico para identificar talentos, facilidade em construir relacionamentos e respira o ecossistema de tecnologia, seu lugar é aqui.


Suas Atribuições e Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de Ciclo Completo (End-to-End): Conduzir todas as etapas do processo seletivo, desde o entendimento da demanda até o fechamento da vaga.


  • Alinhamento de Perfil: Analisar descritivos de cargos e realizar reuniões de alinhamento com os gestores/demandantes para garantir assertividade na busca.


  • Hunting Estratégico: Realizar busca ativa (hunting) e gestão de candidaturas passivas para posições de média e alta complexidade (Devs, QAs, SREs, Product Owners, etc.).


  • Avaliação por Competências e Valores: Conduzir entrevistas focadas em soft skills, comportamento e aderência cultural, garantindo que o talento esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e aos do cliente.


  • Análise Crítica: Elaborar pareceres de candidatos, destacando pontos fortes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento para embasar as decisões de contratação.


  • Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como parceiro consultivo dos líderes técnicos, provendo dados de mercado e insights sobre o processo.


O perfil que buscamos:


  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada em Recrutamento e Seleção técnico. Experiência anterior em consultorias de TI será considerada um grande diferencial.


  • Hands-on: Mentalidade executora, que gosta de mergulhar no dia a dia e fazer as coisas acontecerem.


  • Comunicação: Fluidez na comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de negociar e encantar candidatos.


  • Relacionamento e Cooperação: Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe e construir pontes com diferentes áreas.


  • Organização e Detalhe: Rigor com processos, acompanhamento de KPIs e atenção aos detalhes que fazem a diferença na experiência do candidato.

title: Senior Go Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Go Backend Integration Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design and build the systems that connect our core platform to third-party services, real-time messaging infrastructure, and internal data pipelines. You will work across engineering and product teams to define integration strategies that align with our Enterprise Architecture, contributing to both the technical execution and the long-term scalability of our systems.


What You'll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs in Go (Golang)
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party platforms including CommerceTools, Constructor, and others
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of real-time messaging systems using Apache Kafka
  • Work with Postgres and SQL to model, query, and optimize relational data
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline development to support automated builds, testing, and deployments
  • Collaborate with project teams to define requirements and integration strategies aligned with Enterprise Architecture standards


What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, including 3–4+ years of professional Go (Golang) development
  • Proven experience building and consuming REST APIs from commercial software applications
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka or similar real-time event streaming platforms
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL in production environments
  • Familiarity with enterprise, systems, integration, and data architecture standards and frameworks
  • Experience implementing CI/CD practices using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar
  • Fluent English (we communicate only in English)
  • Located in Europe
  • Be able to start full-time within 2 weeks


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience integrating with CommerceTools, Constructor, or similar commerce/search platforms
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience working within an enterprise architecture governance model
  • Background in e-commerce, retail tech, or marketplace platforms

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role manages supplier follow-up after order placement, covering production stages, fabrics, price negotiations, and replenishment orders. It requires close collaboration with suppliers to ensure alignment with SHEIN processes, assess capacity, and support continuous improvements. Strong communication skills and experience working with spreadsheets and data-driven processes are essential.


Responsabilities:

  • Coordinate with designers on new product development, manage monthly first production orders, and ensure sufficient new SKCs for design updates.
  • Manage relationships with assigned garment suppliers, ensure on-time bulk order delivery, and support issue resolution throughout the production process.
  • Support the hunting team in meeting ESG requirements by driving supplier remediation and improving ESG ratings.
  • Analyze production and performance data to help suppliers improve capacity, quality, and delivery timeliness.
  • Establish, optimize, and maintain bulk order operational standards, including system SOPs, and deliver training to order coordinators and suppliers.
  • Continuously improve supply chain processes by identifying optimization opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve lead times.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the apparel industry.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong understanding of garment production processes across all categories, with the ability to resolve production issues.
  • Excellent data analysis skills with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills to drive improvements in delivery performance, quality, and cost efficiency.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Position Overview

  • We are seeking a Senior AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer to join Upstart AEC. This role sits at the intersection of large language model (LLM) systems, agentic workflows, and scalable backend architecture.
  • You will design and build production-grade AI applications from the ground up, translating complex business requirements into intelligent, automated systems. The role is backend-first, with a strong focus on AI architecture, integration, and implementation. Frontend exposure is helpful but not the primary focus.
  • You should be comfortable working in cloud environments (on-premise and cloud-based platforms), with strong cloud-agnostic competency. Deep expertise in a specific cloud provider is not required, but a solid understanding of cloud architecture principles is essential.

Key Responsibilities


AI Systems & Architecture

  • Design and build AI-native applications leveraging LLMs and agentic frameworks
  • Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector store integrations
  • Implement autonomous, goal-driven AI workflows using LangChain and related frameworks
  • Ensure performance, observability, and reliability of AI-powered systems
  • Build core AI architecture, integrations, and implementations from scratch or using AI automation platforms for smaller engagements


Application & Backend Development

  • Develop and scale RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
  • Build modern AI applications using Python (primary) and TypeScript
  • Integrate backend systems using Python or Go
  • Design and manage data systems using Postgres and Redis
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and maintain strong development best practices
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate logistics, monetization, and operational requirements into scalable technical systems

Required Skills


Programming & Backend Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend development and AI model integration
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Extensive experience designing, scaling, and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Deep understanding of Postgres and Redis
  • Experience building production-grade systems


AI-Native & Agentic Development

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI principles and autonomous system design
  • Experience working with LLMs and generative AI tooling
  • Practical experience with:
  • RAG architectures
  • Vector databases and embeddings
  • Semantic search
  • Dynamic reasoning and task planning workflows


Cloud & Systems

  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles
  • Comfortable working across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Cloud-agnostic competency (AWS experience is beneficial but not mandatory)


Observability & Tooling (Preferred)

  • Experience with AI observability platforms such as LangSmith or similar tools
  • Familiarity with monitoring, debugging, and optimizing LLM application performance


General & Soft Skills

  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability
  • High ownership mindset — able to independently drive initiatives from concept to deployment
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong product intuition and ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes

What Success Looks Like

  • You independently design and ship scalable, production-ready AI systems
  • You proactively identify architectural improvements and performance optimizations
  • You translate business challenges into intelligent, automated workflows
  • You contribute to building a strong AI-native engineering culture

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
About Warmy :)

Warmy.io enhances email deliverability by optimizing domain and IP reputation, ensuring emails land in inboxes instead of spam folders. Our advanced platform simplifies email warming using a unique email seed list.


With integrations like Google Postmaster Tools, Warmy provides actionable insights for superior email performance. Catering to a global audience, Warmy supports email warming in over 30 languages and offers free tools for marketers, such as the Email Deliverability Test and SPF/DMARC Record Generators. Warmy is designed to streamline email deliverability, allowing users to focus on meaningful audience engagement.


Role Description

We are looking for a Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence to own and manage all company analytics. This role is responsible for building a clear view of the business through data, monitoring key metrics on a daily basis, and translating numbers into actionable insights for leadership.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .


Responsabilites:

  • Own the company’s analytics strategy and data visibility across all departments.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.


KPI Monitoring

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de \"security by design\". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário
